inside the application. The macOS framework requires macOS 13.3 or later.

Model weights are downloaded on request from the original publisher; they are
not part of the application archive. StudioPrompter does not modify the weights.
Commands are processed locally. No transcript, script, or audio is sent to a
remote inference service.
